source_notes: First-version modelled constants carried over unchanged from OpticsProfile so P1 can prove byte-identity. No measured grain spectrum or scatter profile exists for any stock yet.

Measured behaviour of these constants is recorded in docs/FILM_OPTICS_V2_P0_BASELINE.zh-CN.md: 60 um grain blobs, Selwyn slope -0.44, 48 um RMS granularity 87, halo half-energy radius 0.66-0.72 mm, +0.95% frame-wide red energy.
dc_mode additive is known to double-count the uniform-field reflection the characteristic curve already contains; P2 switches it to residual.
